newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WINNER OF MEN'S WORLD CUP DOWNHILL.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WINNER OF MEN'S WORLD CUP DOWNHILL.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Luc Alphand, the winner of a men's two-run World Cup downhill on Friday:
Overall World Cup wins: 9 (all downhills): Kitzbuehel I (95, 97), Kitzbuehel II (95), Bormio (95, 96), Vail (95), Val D'Isere (95), Garmisch Partenkirchen (96), Val Gardena (96)
Other feats - Bronze medal in downhill 1996 world championships in Sierra Nevada, Spain.

Alphand has been a regular on the World Cup circuit since 1988 but shot to fame only in the 1994/95 season when he recorded his maiden victories by winning two Kitzbuehel downhills staged on the same day. His sights this winter are firmly set on making the podium at the 1997 world championships in Sestriere, Italy, and on a third successive downhill World Cup title.
